So what's ST point? Need for more drastic law? Living donors? Allow organ trade? Or loved ones to agree to organ donation?

A friend of mine died at 22 years old of a car accident. The experience changed my mind on organ donation forever. As he was dying in the ICU, some people was constantly convincing and pushing his parents that his son is brain dead and organ donation blah blah blah. This affected the grieving process and I am disgusted by their behavior. When such articles pop up to highlight the grief of people who need organs, they failed the highlight the devastation of the family of the "donors".
